title: Money, spending and saving
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a pénzkezelési szokásaidról, a vásárlásról, a reklámokról és a pénzügyi tudatosságról kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: How do you usually manage your money? Do you keep track of what you spend?
Should teenagers get pocket money, or should they earn their own money? Why?
What is the best thing you have ever spent money on? Why?
followUps: Have you ever regretted buying something?

questions.q: How do advertisements influence what you buy?
Do you think young people today are more materialistic than their parents' generation?
What are the risks of shopping online or buying things on credit?
followUps: Do you know anyone who has had a bad experience?

questions.q: Should financial education be taught at school? What should it include?
Do you think money can buy happiness? Why or why not?
What is the biggest financial challenge for young people starting out in life?
If you won a large amount of money, how would you use it?
